name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah. I know everything even without you saying it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh! There's nothing like having a best friend!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You got dumped by Synn, so you want comforting, right? I'll stay up with you all night long」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yet, huh. It's only a matter of time. Come on, cry on big sis's chest」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not it! And who are you calling big sis!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm just kidding. Really, you're such a little hothead, Nana-chan」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we weren't on the phone, I'd give you a pickled plum!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So, what is it? What is it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Could it have something to do with why you joined the Sweets Club?」
